parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS recent FROM alert_dedup WHERE fingerprint = $1 AND last_analyzed_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE
INSERT INTO alert_dedup (fingerprint, alertname, last_analyzed_at) VALUES ($1, $2, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE alertname = VALUES(alertname), last_analyzed_at = NOW()

SELECT ID, USER, DB, COMMAND, TIME, STATE, LEFT(INFO, 300) AS INFO FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE COMMAND <> 'Sleep' AND USER NOT IN ('n8n_diag', 'event_scheduler') ORDER BY TIME DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT trx_id, trx_state, trx_started, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, trx_started, NOW()) AS age_sec, trx_rows_locked, trx_tables_locked, LEFT(trx_query, 300) AS trx_query FROM information_schema.innodb_trx ORDER BY trx_started LIMIT 20

SELECT w.REQUESTING_ENGINE_TRANSACTION_ID AS waiting_trx, w.BLOCKING_ENGINE_TRANSACTION_ID AS blocking_trx, l.OBJECT_SCHEMA, l.OBJECT_NAME, l.INDEX_NAME, l.LOCK_MODE, l.LOCK_DATA FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits w JOIN performance_schema.data_locks l ON l.ENGINE_LOCK_ID = w.BLOCKING_ENGINE_LOCK_ID LIMIT 20

SELECT TABLE_NAME, INDEX_NAME, NON_UNIQUE, GROUP_CONCAT(COLUMN_NAME ORDER BY SEQ_IN_INDEX) AS columns FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'alertlab' GROUP BY TABLE_NAME, INDEX_NAME, NON_UNIQUE
